verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's docs describe an official MCP integration for connecting coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) to its databases. It uses OAuth 2.1 with no API keys and provides tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring. That clearly covers the core of the story, but the evidence is a single docs summary line. missing for 10: in-depth MCP setup/tool reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
